name: 오디오 잡음 바닥 분석
algorithm: Audio Noise Floor — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes the audio noise floor characteristics for deepfake detection following Chen et al. (2020):

1. **노이즈Floor추정**: The background noise level is estimated across frequency bands using minimum statistics or MMSE-based methods. Real audio recordings contain characteristic noise profiles shaped by microphone electronics, room acoustics, and environmental sounds with specific spectral coloring.

2. **스펙트럼노이즈프로파일분석**: The noise floor spectrum is compared against expected characteristics for genuine recordings. Real microphones produce noise with predictable spectral shape (often pink/brownian). AI-generated audio typically produces either unnaturally clean signals (absence of environmental noise) or artificially added noise with incorrect spectral characteristics.

3. **시간적노이즈일관성**: The noise floor is tracked across the recording duration. In authentic recordings, ambient noise varies naturally with room dynamics but maintains consistent spectral character. Deepfake audio may show noise floor discontinuities at splice points or unnatural noise stationarity across the entire clip.

4. **노이즈-신호상관분석**: In real recordings, background noise acoustically interacts with the speech signal via room reverberation. The method checks whether noise-signal correlations follow physical room acoustic models. Synthesized speech overlaid on separately generated or copied noise lacks these natural cross-correlations.

5. **Quantization노이즈평가**: The quantization noise pattern is examined for codec consistency. Re-encoded deepfake audio shows double-quantization artifacts in the noise floor — subtle but detectable statistical irregularities in the least significant bits that differ from single-pass recording chains.
parameters:
분석 유형: sensor
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through audio noise floor analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
